title: Iván Cepeda Concedes Colombia's Presidential Runoff After Challenging Results
detail: June 24, 2026 — Iván Cepeda formally conceded Colombia's June 21 presidential runoff to Abelardo de la Espriella after briefly challenging the count from roughly 57,000 polling stations — nearly half the country's total — citing the race's razor-thin margin. The concession cleared the way for a transition that was widely expected to substantially scale back President Petro's 'Total Peace' negotiated-settlement policy toward the ELN and FARC-dissident groups.
